verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
Holy Spirit
I love it when You're near
You're a friend to me
You're the air I breathe

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
Holy Spirit
You are all I need
When it's You and me
I will never leave

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
Your presence my comfort
Your friendship the joy of my heart
When you speak I'll listen
Holy Spirit

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
You walk in triumphant
No darkness can stand to Your light
When you come close I'll lean in
Holy Spirit

verse.name: b1a
verse.lines:
You are not simply a concept
You're a person
You are not a made up ghost
Or some illusion

verse.name: b1b
verse.lines:
You are God
The Living Breath that brought me back to life
You are God
The gift of Heavens Bridegroom to His bride
